functions.name: register
functions.description: Replace all single-key bindings. Returns one report entry per binding.

id.description: Command name, matching a key of manifest.commands.

shortcut.description: A bare key ("S") or a Shift combination ("Shift+S").

functions.name: check
functions.description: Report whether a shortcut is usable and what it would shadow.

events.name: onCommand
events.description: A registered single key was pressed in a mail window.

parameters.name: tabId
parameters.description: Mail tab the key was pressed in; -1 when it could not be resolved.
